defects.title: solverType is documented as optional with default 'LP' but cannot be omitted
defects.observed: error 'Solver type feasTol is not supported by the COBRA Toolbox' (the first input is always the solver type; USAGE lists three inputs)
defects.expected: per INPUTS ("solverType: ... (opt, default, 'LP')"), the LP parameter feasTol set

defects.title: The error for a parameter that is not allowed always names LP solvers
defects.observed: the error message is 'Parameter name minNorm not allowed for LP solvers'
defects.expected: a message naming the solver type given, MILP

notes: Revision by lead decision (wave 09): the omitted-solverType defect, recorded as cosmetic in wave 03, is reclassified unusable-option; the test is converted to the quarantine layout (header defects kept, body = opening with prepareTest() only). Reproduction: changeCobraSolverParams('feasTol', 1e-9) -> error 'Solver type feasTol is not supported by the COBRA Toolbox'. Quarantine reach: confined to the call form that omits solverType (two arguments); callers that pass three arguments are not reached (lead to confirm by grep). The wave-03 assertions are no longer in the file (see git history of the test for the previous version).
confirmed_by: lead (source read: the header documents solverType as optional with default 'LP', line 9, but it is the first positional argument, line 1); severity raised to unusable-option by the lead (consistency rule, revision of wave 03)
